source: ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis via Open-Meteo (era5_seamless), at each fire's centroid

fire_weather.equations: Van Wagner (1987) Canadian Forest Fire Weather Index System, standard daily version
fire_weather.startup_date: first day of each fire's weather record (1 April, or 30 days before the fire if earlier)
fire_weather.rain: sum of the 24 hours ending at local noon
fire_weather.overwintering: not applied; every season starts from the standard values
